card_en: From five on, the noun after a number is in the genitive plural: pet evrov, deset jajc, sto jabolk. With one to four it is not: eno jajce, dve jajci, tri jajca.

quick_check.explain_en: From five on, the noun takes the genitive plural: pet evrov.

helper_de: German uses the plain plural after every number: fünf Eier. Slovenian switches to the genitive plural from five on: pet jajc.
helper_en: English adds -s from two on: five eggs. Slovenian has one form for two, one for three and four, and the genitive plural from five: pet jajc.
